{{Quote|The best navy I can imagine. It is modern, streamlined, and high-tech, unbeaten in any conflict since Endor. It has liberated the galaxy from the worst tyranny in known history, and is capable of handling any threat that the New Republic could imagine.|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''New Republic Defense Fleet''', commonly referred to as the '''New Republic Navy''' or the '''New Republic Space Navy''', was the name of the defense [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
At the creation of the New Republic, the former [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] consisted primarily of donated [[Starship/Legends|starships]] converted to military duty, volunteer resistance force fleets and a small number of vessels purchased with limited [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] funds, headed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], who also held a seat on the [[New Republic Provisional Council]]. During this period, Ackbar coordinated the Fleet towards the Council's primary goal: the capture of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Along the way, the Fleet engaged a number of Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] and relied heavily upon its officers' ingenuity to defeat the warlords' superior warships.

After the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation of Coruscant]], the New Republic reorganized under the [[New Republic Common Charter|Common Charter]], which also organized the military might of the New Republic into a single, unified command structure, the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]]. Starships, [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and soldiers all served under the [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], an office built from the remains of the [[Minister of Defense (New Republic)|Minister of Defense]], [[Minister of the Army]], [[Minister of the Navy]] and the [[Minister of the Starfighter Corps]]. While the Defense Force was organized into [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]], Intelligence, Technology and Quartermaster sections, the Defense Fleet served as its primary action body, and was led directly by the Supreme Commander, Ackbar.

Ostensibly it was during this period that the Navy began to organize into [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]]. These groups patrolled segments of the New Republic on a rotating basis, with at least one always assigned to defending Coruscant and another assigned to patrolling "[[Thunder Alley]]." Prior to [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], four fleets were created to fulfill this function.

[[File:BattleOfYagDhul.jpg|thumb|left|250px|New Republic reinforcements at the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (26 ABY)|Battle of Yag'Dhul]]]]

In the nine years following the reorganization of the fleet, the variety of vessels that comprised the Defense Fleet grew; starships from hundreds of shipyards across New Republic space made up the frontline, support and civilian vessels of the Fleet. The resulting inefficiencies of this diversity prompted a program to streamline the Fleet's ships and increase maintenance efficiency. This program, named [[New Class Modernization Program|New Class]], offered the Fleet a new level of standardization, power and flexibility previously enjoyed by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]]. By 16 ABY, a new fleet, the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|New Republic Fifth Battle Group]] constructed wholly of New Class starships completed its proving missions and demonstrated the success of the program in the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].

Ignoring Imperial design philosophy and opting for a larger number of smaller ship-designs, the New Republic built fleet [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]], [[Republic-class Star Destroyer|''Republic''-class Star Destroyers]] and smaller [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruisers]], shying away from Super Star Destroyer-sized warships.<ref name="SOL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> However, the Navy's fleets were designed as response forces and, despite the concerns of some politicians during the launch of the Fifth Fleet, not a tool of conquest. The lessons learned from the Black Fleet Crisis eventually took form as the [[Star Defender]] program, which had its own set of detractors and moved ahead slowly.<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

Thus, the Navy was not able to easily launch counter-offensives against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in the late stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], and once again had to rely on its talented commanders to achieve victories. During that conflict, [[Mediator-class battle cruiser|''Mediator''-class battle cruisers]], [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]]s and [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defenders]] comprised the fleet's "signature ships".<ref name="AOCI:HT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>
With the collapse of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the formation of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the New Republic Defense Fleet formally ceased to exist, and was replaced by the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]].<ref name="TFP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>

==Organization==
===Headquarters===
The Defense Fleet, and the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Defense Forces]] as a whole, were headed by the [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], who took orders from the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]], the civilian leader of the New Republic. In the first few years after [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]], the Defense Forces were organized under the Ministry of Defense, which had been reorganized from the Rebel Alliance's [[Ministry of War (Alliance)|Ministry of War]], with separate a ministry below it for the Fleet. In practice this proved overly-bureaucratic and cumbersome, and following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the whole command structure was reorganized again, with the position of Minister of Defense being abolished the Supreme Commander becoming a [[New Republic Ruling Council|Ruling Council]] position.

[[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]] was the senior professional military body in control of the Defense Forces, which in turn controlled [[Fleet Command (New Republic)/Legends|Fleet Command]].<ref name="BTS" /> The [[New Republic Fleet Office]] was another controlling element of the Defense Fleet, which had authority over the Fleet, [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence]], and the [[New Republic Marine]]s.<ref name="NJOSourcebook">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref>

===Administrative organization===
The [[New Republic Marine]]s, bridgehead commandos responsible for leading [[Planetary assault tactics|planetary assaults]], were a component of the Defense Fleet.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" /> [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence]] was another component of the Defense Fleet responsible for military intelligence, which included [[Asset Tracking]], a department responsible for tracking Imperial military equipment lost after Endor.<ref name="BTS" />

===Tactical organization===
The Defense Fleet was built around four main fleets and area commands, derived from the four original fleets that had conducted the advance on Coruscant from [[4 ABY/Legends|4]] to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Early organization emphasized flexibility, with pre-existing [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and [[Flotilla/Legends|flotillas]] from the old [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] remaining intact and local loyalties being taken into account. [[Battle group/Legends|Battle groups]] were designed so they could be shifted within the four main fleets as required or if necessary deployed independently, such as the [[Solo Fleet]] deployed against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="Warfare" />

As the New Republic grew, Admiral Ackbar was faced with the challenge of creating a unified navy out of the disparate units that had comprised the Rebel Alliance's [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]], which had contrasting regulations, tactics and traditions. To achieve this, the squadrons that had not originally been part of the central Alliance [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]] were largely broken up and their ships and crews sent to different units. This provoked a degree of resistance, and the [[Combined Bothan Clans|Bothan Council]] and the [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|Corellian Resistance]] responded by withdrawing most of their units from the navy, but on the whole Defense Fleet integration proceeded quickly. By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic First Fleet]] guarded [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as the Home Fleet, while the [[New Republic Second Fleet|Second]] defended [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], the [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the [[New Republic Fourth Fleet|Fourth]], [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]]. This arrangement fought in the [[Thrawn campaign]], the Imperial [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|advance]] out of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], and [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="Warfare" />

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] the [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] and [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] forces met standards for strength, unity and discipline, allowing a more sweeping military reform. All federal military forces were placed under the four fleet commands as part of a integrated Defense Force. Naval battle groups became subcommands with defined sectors of operations, with large forces blockading the main Imperial holdouts and smaller squadrons assigned to peacekeeping patrols inside New Republic territory. One battle group in each fleet served as a mobile reserve, but temporary attachments of multi-role [[Task force/Legends|task forces]] could turn each battle group into a powerful fighting fleet. These task forces were standardized squadrons built around a mix of vessels with complementary capabilities, designed to perform equally well at different mission profiles. The standard deployment was three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] or [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruisers]], with two light [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]], four escorts, and five attack ships. Also attached were a line of scouts and support vessels. Standing orders mandated that the balance of ships in each task force should be roughly equal rather than allowing [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] or pickets to become overrepresented, so that the number of task forces in a battle group defined its role rather than the internal balance of ships.<ref name="Warfare" />

After the reorganization led to the four fleets becoming increasingly tied-down as territorial deployments, a new rapid-reaction command was activated in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]. The [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Roving Battle Group]] contained five task forces, and fought with distinction in the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. The Fifth Battle Group was soon assigned full fleet status, and by [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet]] was enlarged to a full strength of five hundred [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in five battle groups.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Starships of the New Republic Defense Fleet==
===Dreadnoughts===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the New Republic captured at least two [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]], which were [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']] and ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]],'' and there is a [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|Bellator-class dreadnought]] appeared to be in service during the time of [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn Crisis]]. As part of the [[Star Defender]] Program,  [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defenders]] were manufactured at [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] while [[Strident-class Star Defender|''Strident''-class Star Defenders]] saw production on Corellia.

===Capital ships===
The defense fleet utilized various [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], from [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruisers]], [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruisers]], [[MC80a Star Cruiser]]s, and [[MC80B Star Cruiser]]s were all part of the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] line. [[MC90 Star Cruiser]]s were heavy based weapon platforms, and were often stationed within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Mediator-class battle cruiser|''Mediator''-class battle cruisers]] were advanced later generation Mon Cala cruisers.

[[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Nebula''-class Star Destroyers]] were also used as a capital-class. ''Nebula''-class was capable of going head to head against an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. [[Republic-class Star Destroyer|''Republic''-class Star Destroyers]] were [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]/[[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] based ships design by the infamous [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]]. Another ship that often found itself as head of a fleet or task force was the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|Endurance-Class Fleet Carrier]].

The fleet did use captured [[Procursator-class Star Destroyer|''Procursator''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class]] and [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]], as well as [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class]] and [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyers]].

===Other Cruisers===
[[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruisers]] were equipped with [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]], which prevented starships from going to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and even pulling them out of hyperspace, were used. At least five [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser]]s made their way into the navy.

At least one [[Bulwark Mark I]], or ''Bulwark''-class battleship, was deployed at the [[Battle of Mindor]]. Two [[Acclamator II-class assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator II''-class assault ships]] also were sent to [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]]. The defense fleet used multiple [[Bulwark Mark III]], or ''Bulwark''-class battlecruisers. [[Shieldship]]s, designed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], were employed. It was designed to withstand a nearby star, or be used as a utility craft.

Other cruiser classes were made use of, including [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]], [[Republic-class cruiser|''Republic''-class cruisers]], [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruisers]], [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]]s, [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]], [[Majestic-class heavy cruiser|''Majestic''-class heavy cruisers]] and [[Defender-class assault carrier|''Defender''-class assault carriers]]. [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-Class bulk cruisers]] were used as starfighter carriers.

With an alliance with the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes]] [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Consortium]], the fleet had access to [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s and [[Nova-class battle cruiser|''Nova''-class battle cruisers]].

'''Frigates/Light Cruisers'''

The fleet used several different variants of [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] and light cruisers including [[MC30c frigate/Legends|MC30c frigates]], [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 frigates]], [[Class-C frigate/Legends|Class-C frigates]],[[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]], an [[Alderaanian War Frigate]], [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]], and [[Assault Frigate Mark I]] variant, its [[Assault Frigate Mark II/Legends|Mark II]] variation, [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]], and [[Proficient-class light cruiser|''Proficient''-class light cruisers]]. [[Sacheen-class light escort|''Sacheen''-class light escorts]] were later introduced as well.

'''Corvettes/Picket Ships'''

[[Corvette/Legends|Corvettes]] were used heavily, using [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], and [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]] and [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigates]]. The New Class Modernization Program produced [[Agave-class picket ship|''Agave''-class picket ships]] and [[Warrior-class gunship|''Warrior''-class gunships]].

'''Support Vessels'''

[[Hajen-class fleet tender|''Hajen''-class fleet tenders]] were necessary because of standard New Republic military doctrine. Unlike the Empire, who focused on large one ship battle groups that could support itself for upwards of a year, New Republic fleets needed much more resupplying. [[Ferret-class reconnaissance vessel]]s and [[Prowler-class reconnaissance vessel]]s were both dedicated spy and recon ships.

[[Freighter/Legends|Freighters]] were used to transport medical supplies, weapons, and other material for the war efforts, These included [[YKL-37R Nova Courier]]s, [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]], [[YT-2400 light freighter|YT-2400 freighters]], [[YZ-775 medium transport]]s, [[GX1 short hauler]]s, [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighters]], [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transports]], and [[ZV-9 freighter]]s.

===Transports===
[[Jadthu-class landing ship/Legends|''Jadthu''-class landing ships]], [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]], [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]], [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]], [[Marketta-class shuttle|''Marketta''-class shuttles]], [[Bantha-class troop carrier assault shuttle|''Bantha''-class troop carrier assault shuttles]], [[Mu-2 long range shuttle]]s, [[Ranger-class gunship|''Ranger''-class gunships]], [[orbital jumper]]s, and [[fleet shuttle]]s served as primary transports. [[Mynock-class assault boat|''Mynock''-class assault boats]] were boarding crafts designed to capture enemy [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. [["Out System" Scout Vessel]]s were used for exploration, finding and surveying new [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

===Starfighters===
[[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], [[T-65A2 X-wing starfighter]]s, [[T-65A3 X-wing starfighter]]s, [[T-65AC4 X-wing starfighter]]s, [[T-65BR X-wing reconnaissance starfighter]]s, [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighters]], [[T-65XJ3 X-wing starfighter]]s, [[TX-65 X-wing starfighter]]s, [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]], [[A-9 Vigilance interceptor]]s, [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighters]], [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]]s, [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighters]], [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s, [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z95 Headhunters]], [[Defender starfighter]]s, [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighters]], and [[drone fighter]]s. [[LightStealth-18 Reconnaissance Ship|''Lightstealth''-18 Reconnaissance Ships]] were used in recon, and were fast and stealth.

===Space stations===
The fleet used numerous space stations, including [[Dibrook Space Station]], ''[[Kothlis II]]'', [[Yag-prime]], and [[Caluula Station]]. [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] held [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun|Golan III space defense platforms]] for its orbital defense. Multiple [[Empress-class space station|''Empress''-class space stations]] found there use for the fleet as well. During [[Operation Shadow Hand]], commando teams were able to capture [[World Devastator (New Republic)|one]] [[World Devastator]]. It was used to recycle derelict spacecraft in orbit of [[Da Soocha V]]. Many other captured World Devastators were used as well expect they were mainly assigned for scrapping ships. Several [[Worldcraft]] were employed into the fleet, it is unknown what they were used for. [[Hosk Station]], an [[Esseles-class space station|''Esseles''-class space station]], was used.
